raw_text: A Chinese navy task group led by a Type 055 guided-missile destroyer has entered the Indian Ocean for what military sources described as a routine far-seas training exercise. The deployment comes as China continues to expand its naval footprint beyond the first island chain. India's navy has scrambled P-8I maritime patrol aircraft to monitor the movements, Indian defence sources told the Post. Beijing said the exercise is part of annual training plans.
clean_text: PLAN Type 055-led task group entered Indian Ocean for far-seas training. China expanding naval presence beyond first island chain. India monitoring with P-8I aircraft.
